# 文 in the grammar of continuation

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`wen-in-the-grammar` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](wen-in-the-grammar.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read with a law's step as 缘 and a map's values as a class, 文同 is the core of the value class and so is likeness by bisimulation; the coarsest value-keeping class is the core; the states of a 文 are its core along the steps; the bounded laws and learnability are restated through the core.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A determined law's step is 缘 and a map's values a class: a relation is constant under the step exactly where the law keeps it, and a class keeps the values and carries the law exactly where it lies in the value class and is constant. (`Becoming.Law.constant_iff_keeps`, `Becoming.Law.keepsAndCarries_iff`, `Becoming.Law.kept_along`, `Becoming.Law.step`, `Becoming.Law.step_hasSucc_iff`, `Becoming.sameValue`, `Becoming.sameValue_class`)
2. The same course through the map (文同) is the core of the value class under the law's step, and likeness by bisimulation in the frame by the map is that core; a class keeping the values and carrying the law contains the core exactly where it is the core, a symmetric constant relation inside a class containing its core exactly where it is the core. (`Becoming.Law.alike_iff_core`, `Becoming.Law.coarsest_iff_core`, `Becoming.Law.core_is_sameFuture`, `Becoming.contains_core_iff`)
3. Under the value class a configuration's line ends exactly where the value changes at the next step, every line runs along the orbit, and the line never ends exactly where the course is constant from there; a step continues under the core exactly where the line under the value class never ends; the value class is constant exactly where it is its own core, and then a course keeping its value for one step keeps it for good. (`Becoming.Law.constant_iff_core`, `Becoming.Law.continues_in_core_iff`, `Becoming.Law.ends_iff_changes`, `Becoming.Law.line_on_orbit`, `Becoming.Law.reached_while_same`, `Becoming.Law.stays_of_constant`, `Becoming.Law.unending_iff`)
4. Two moments of a 文 are one state exactly where they lie in one class of the core of its value class along the steps, the steps being the successor law's; a state goes on as itself by the core's constancy; along a law's course the core on moments is the core on configurations; a 文 with a new value at every moment has no continuation under its core. (`Becoming.SameAhead.is_core`, `Becoming.SameAhead.next_by_root`, `Becoming.SameAhead.no_continuation`, `Becoming.Steps.next_is_step`, `Becoming.course_core_iff`)
5. With at most N states the core of a 文 is read off N + N - 1 steps, and at most N states is at most N classes of the core, each met before N; for a law on a listed world the core is read off N + N - 1 steps, N the list's length. Two 文 read as one net on the sum of their moments have two moments in one class of the core exactly where the courses agree from there; with at most N and N' states, exactly where they agree before N + N' - 1, a length that is exact. (`Becoming.Law.core_iff_below`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.core_exact`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.core_iff`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.core_iff_bounded`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.next`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.orbit_inl`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.orbit_inr`, `Becoming.TwoCourses.value`, `Becoming.core_iff_below`, `Becoming.statesBelow_iff_core`)
6. In a world a list holds, a feature is learnable through a map exactly where configurations in one class of the core of the map's value class have features that agree from some step on; a feature whose class contains that core is learnable, and a core lies in another class's core exactly where it lies in that class. (`Becoming.Law.learnable_iff_core`, `Becoming.Law.learnable_of_core_within`, `Becoming.core_within_core_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: a determined law (a function) and a map; for the bounded laws at most N (and N') states or a list holding every configuration closed under the law; for learnability a list holding every configuration and decided equality of the map's values. Equality of values is the model's commitment; discrete steps.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That 文同 is a continuation: it is the core; continuation under the value class is one step that keeps the value, and continuation under the core is a course constant from there.
- Instances for classes that are not kernels of maps, for a relation that is not a function (the branching of a nondeterministic process), or for the two-valued class of Arising and Change, which compares by ↔ and would need propext to be a map's kernel.
- The prefix (往), the bounds as numbers, the extrapolations and learnability's "from some step on" in the grammar's own terms: the grammar has no counting or lists, and these are stated beside the core.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
